note: Per-tile connected-component label grid (undirected 4-connectivity over passable tiles; -1 = blocked). Lets the runtime resolve which component a tile is in via O(1) lookup instead of recomputing a flood fill. Component indices match mapGraph.json nodes' `component` field 1:1 — a node exists for every component, even portal-free pockets (which simply carry no edges and are unreachable by BFS).
gridFormat: row-major, index = y*width + x; value = component index or -1
